title: Just Friends?
description: The complete graded reader staged with reusable backgrounds and character expressions.

text.chinese: 钱大朋和谢文东都是中山大学的大学生，今年是他们大学的第二年。
text.english: Qian Dapeng and Xie Wendong are both students at Sun Yat-sen University; this year is their second year at the university.

text.chinese: 他们天天一起去吃饭，一起去看书，两个人是很好的朋友。
text.english: They go eating together every day, and read books together; the two of them are very good friends.

text.chinese: 谢文东的爸爸妈妈开饭店。
text.english: Xie Wendong's parents run a restaurant.

text.chinese: 谢文东有时候会带钱大朋去饭店吃饭。
text.english: Xie Wendong sometimes takes Qian Dapeng to a restaurant for dinner.

text.chinese: 谢文东的爸爸妈妈都见过钱大朋。
text.english: Xie Wendong’s parents have met Qian Dapeng.

text.chinese: 钱大朋有时候也会开车带谢文东回家。
text.english: Qian Dapeng sometimes drives to take Xie Wendong home too.

text.chinese: 钱大朋不喜欢吃大学的饭，天天都出去吃。
text.english: Qian Dapeng doesn’t like eating at university cafeterias and goes out to eat every day.

text.chinese: 钱大朋的爸爸妈妈很有钱，每个月都给儿子很多钱。
text.english: Qian Dapeng’s parents are very wealthy; they give a lot of money to their son every month.

text.chinese: “大朋，你有车，天天开车来大学。
text.english: “Dapeng, you have a car; come to the university every day by car.”
“You must be very happy!”
spoken by Wen Dong and Da Peng.
“I’m not happy at all!”

text.chinese: 我从小到大都跟我爸妈在一起，我做什么他们都要问。”
text.english: I have been with my parents since I was a child; they always ask about everything I do.

text.chinese: 钱大朋不开心地说，“我一点也不喜欢这样的家。”
text.english: Qian Dapeng said unhappily, “I really don’t like this house at all.”
“They care about you.”
“Isn’t that bad?”
Xie Wendong asks.
“I know they care about me.”

text.chinese: 可是，有时候‘太关心了’，我不知道怎么跟他们说。”
text.english: However, sometimes “I care too much,” and I don’t know how to tell them.

text.chinese: 钱大朋说，“我回家的时候，我妈天天问我有没有女朋友。”
text.english: Qian Dapeng said, “When I get home, my mother asks me every day if I have a girlfriend.”
“How do you say?”
“I don’t know how to say it.”

text.chinese: 说有，我妈会马上想和我的女朋友见面。
text.english: Yes, my mom will definitely want to meet up with my girlfriend right away.

text.chinese: 说没有，我妈会叫我去见一个女生，跟那个女生去吃饭什么的。
text.english: No, my mom will ask me to meet a girl, and go eating with her.

text.chinese: 可是，我一点也不喜欢那个女生。
text.english: But I really don’t like that girl at all.
I don’t want to meet her either.

text.chinese: “那，你妈知不知道你不喜欢那个女生？”
text.english: “So, does your mom know that you don’t like that girl?”

text.chinese: “她知道，我说过很多次，可是，那个女生是一个大学生，她是我爸的一个好朋友的女儿。
text.english: “She knows, I’ve told her many times, but that girl is a college student—she’s the daughter of a good friend of my father.”
My dad really likes it.
I really don’t like it at all.

text.chinese: 谢文东听了笑笑，不知道说什么。
text.english: Xie Wendong smiled and chuckled, not knowing what to say.

text.chinese: “大朋，我们大学那么多好看的女生，你没有喜欢的吗？”
text.english: “Dapeng, there are so many beautiful girls in our university. Don’t you have a favorite?”
During dinner, Xie Wendong asked.

text.chinese: 大朋看看文东，笑了笑：“你看到什么了？”
text.english: Dapeng looked at Wendo and smiled: “What did you see?”

text.chinese: “这几天，我看你都在看周子心。
text.english: “These days, I see that you’re always looking at Zhou Zixin.”

text.chinese: 上次，我跟你说话你都没有听见。
text.english: Last time, you didn’t hear what I said.
Do you like her?
“I like her, so what?”
Qian Dapeng laughed.

text.chinese: 文东看看大朋，没有笑：“我也喜欢她。”
text.english: Wen Dong looks at Da Peng but doesn’t smile: “I like her too.”

text.chinese: 大朋一下子不笑了，也不吃了：“不是吧？
text.english: Dapeng stopped laughing and eating immediately: “Is that really true?”

text.chinese: 从什么时候……我怎么一点也不知道？”
text.english: “Since when... I have no idea.”

text.chinese: “我和她都喜欢看书，我在书店见过她很多次。
text.english: “She and I both love reading; I’ve seen her many times in a bookstore.”

text.chinese: 她是一个好女生，也很好看……谁会不喜欢？”
text.english: She’s a great girl, and she’s also very attractive… Who wouldn’t like her?
“So, did you talk to her?”
Dapeng asked carefully.

text.chinese: “没有，她不知道我喜欢她……”文东不说了。
text.english: “No, she doesn’t know that I like her…” Wen Dong said no more.
“I didn’t tell her either.”
Da Peng says.
“Dapeng, are we good friends?”
Xie Wendong asks.
“Yes, so what?

text.chinese: 周子心不是你的女朋友，对不对？”
text.english: “Zhou Zixin isn’t your girlfriend, right?”
Dapeng asked carefully.

text.chinese: 文东生气地看大朋：“你怎么能这样说？”
text.english: Wen Dong looked at Da Peng angrily and said, “How can you say that?”
Da Peng knows that Wen Dong is angry.

text.chinese: 大朋跟他说：“好了好了，我知道你要说什么。
text.english: Dapeng said to him, “Okay, okay, I know what you’re going to say.”

text.chinese: 我们是好朋友，我是不会跟你喜欢的女生一起出去的。”
text.english: We are good friends; I won’t go out with the girl you like.
Wen Dong laughed and said, “Great!”

text.chinese: 我也是不会跟她一起出去的！”
text.english: I also won’t go out with her!

text.chinese: 星期四晚上，很多学生都在一起说话。
text.english: On Thursday night, many students were talking together.
Xie Wendong is not there.

text.chinese: 两个男生问钱大朋：“大朋，你是不是喜欢周子心？”
text.english: Two boys asked Qian Dapeng, “Dapeng, do you like Zhou Zixin?”
“No… who told you that?”
Da Peng says.

text.chinese: “没有人说，可是，大家都知道了。”
text.english: “No one said it, but everyone knows.”
Two boys laughed.
“Okay, okay, don’t laugh.”
Yes, I like her.
“So what?”

text.chinese: 钱大朋也笑了一下，“我出去走走。”
text.english: Qian Dapeng also smiled and said, “I’m going out for a walk.”

text.chinese: 这时候，钱大朋看到了周子心。
text.english: At that moment, Qian Dapeng saw Zhou Zixin.

text.chinese: “周子心，这么晚了，你一个人去哪儿？”
text.english: “Zhou Zi Xin, it’s so late—where are you going alone?”
Qian Dapeng asks her.
Zhou Zixin looked and said, “Qian Dapeng?”

text.chinese: 她笑了一下，“我要去书店。”
text.english: She laughed and said, “I’m going to the bookstore.”
“That big bookstore?”
Qian Dapeng asks.

text.chinese: “对，这里有车可以去那个很大的书店。”
text.english: “Yes, there’s a car that can take you to that large bookstore.”
Zhou Zixin smiled.
“By the time you return, it will be past 9 o’clock.”

text.chinese: 你一个人回来不行……我开车带你去吧。”
text.english: You can’t come back alone… I’ll drive you there.

text.chinese: 钱大朋笑笑说，“周子心，我们走吧。
text.english: Qian Dapeng said with a smile, “Zhou Zixin, let’s go.”
“The car is over there.”

text.chinese: 谢文东晚上在外面和朋友吃饭，回来的时候，他看到了钱大朋在车里，车里还有周子心。
text.english: Xie Wendong went out to eat with friends in the evening. When he returned, he saw Qian Dapeng in the car, and Zhou Zixin was also in the car.
“Qian Dapeng, you are not my friend!”
Wen Dong shouted loudly.

text.chinese: 可是，大朋什么也没听到，开车走了。
text.english: But Da Peng heard nothing and drove away.

text.chinese: 文东很生气，他马上叫了车，也去了那个书店。
text.english: Wen Dong was very angry; he immediately called a car and went to that bookstore too.

text.chinese: 到了书店，周子心跟钱大朋说：“你去哪里？”
text.english: When they arrived at the bookstore, Zhou Zixin asked Qian Dapeng, “Where are you going?”
“I’m going out for a walk.”
Qian Dapeng says.
“In a bit, I’ll drive you back.”

text.chinese: 周子心说：“你和我一起去吧。
text.english: Zhou Zixin said, “Go with me.”

text.chinese: 你可以看看有没有你喜欢的书。”
text.english: You can check if there are any books you like.

text.chinese: 钱大朋想了想，和周子心一起去书店了。
text.english: Qian Dapeng thought for a moment and went to the bookstore with Zhou Zixin.

text.chinese: 谢文东看到他们去了书店，谢文东也去了书店。
text.english: Xie Wendong saw them go to the bookstore, so he also went there.

text.chinese: 过了一会儿，周子心跟钱大朋说：“大朋，我们出去吃一点东西吧。”
text.english: After a while, Zhou Zixin said to Qian Dapeng, "Dapeng, let’s go out and eat something."
He looked at Zhou Zixin and said, “Good.”

text.chinese: 说完，大朋和周子心去了书店外面的小吃店。
text.english: After speaking, Da Peng and Zhou Zixin went to a snack shop outside the bookstore.
In the snack shop, there aren’t many people.

text.chinese: 钱大朋说：“点你喜欢吃的小吃吧。
text.english: Qian Dapeng said, “Let’s order some snacks you like.”
All the snacks here are very delicious.

text.chinese: 周子心笑了笑说：“谢谢你开车带我过来，你点吧。”
text.english: Zhou Zixin smiled and said, “Thank you for driving me here. You go ahead.”

text.chinese: 这时候，钱大朋听到一个男生叫他：“钱大朋！”
text.english: At that moment, Qian Dapeng heard a boy calling out to him: “Qian Dapeng!”
“Xie Wendong?”

text.chinese: 你怎么在这里……”钱大朋说。
text.english: “How do you get here…” Qian Dapeng said.

text.chinese: 谢文东生气地看了看钱大朋：“你和周子心怎么会在一起……我们不是好朋友吗？”
text.english: Xie Wendong looked at Qian Dapeng angrily and said, “How can you be with Zhou Zixin… aren’t we good friends?”
“It’s not what you think.”

text.chinese: 她要来书店，我开车带她来书店。”
text.english: She’s going to the bookstore, so I’ll drive her there.
“I saw it too!”

text.chinese: 谢文东说，“你们两个在一起多长时间了？”
text.english: Xie Wendong asked, “How long have you two been together?”
“Xie Wendong, what are you saying?”

text.chinese: 周子心马上说，“我没和钱大朋在一起，他也不是我男朋友。”
text.english: Zhou Zixin immediately said, “I wasn’t with Qian Dapeng, and he isn’t my boyfriend.”

text.chinese: “钱大朋，谢文东为什么那样说？”
text.english: “Qian Dapeng, why did Xie Wendong say that?”
Zhou Zixin asked.

text.chinese: 钱大朋不知道对周子心说什么。
text.english: Qian Dapeng doesn’t know what to say to Zhou Zixin.

text.chinese: 他看谢文东不说话，他也不说话。
text.english: He sees that Xie Wendong doesn’t speak, so he also stays silent.

text.chinese: 周子心说：“好吧，要是你们都没什么要说的，那我走了。”
text.english: Zhou Zixin said, “Okay, if you all have nothing to say, then I’m leaving.”
She left.

text.chinese: 谢文东说：“钱大朋，你怎么能这样做？
text.english: Xie Wendong said, “Qian Dapeng, how can you do this?”
“Aren’t we good friends?”
“What did I do?”
I didn’t do anything!

text.chinese: 钱大朋又说：“你为什么要来这里？”
text.english: Qian Dapeng asked again, “Why do you come here?”

text.chinese: 谢文东小心地说：“要是我没有来这里，谁知道你们会做什么……”“谢文东，你听我说，我和周子心不是男朋友和女朋友！”
text.english: Xie Wendong said carefully, “If I hadn’t come here, who knows what you would have done…” “Xie Wendong, listen to me—I am not boyfriend and girlfriend to Zhou Zixin!”

text.chinese: 说完，钱大朋生气地走了。
text.english: After saying that, Qian Dapeng left angrily.

text.chinese: 第二天，钱大朋和谢文东还是不说话。
text.english: On the second day, Qian Dapeng and Xie Wendong still didn’t speak.

text.chinese: 吃饭的时候，周子心看到谢文东一个人在吃饭。
text.english: While eating, Zhou Zixin saw Xie Wendong eating alone.

text.chinese: 她问谢文东：“谢文东，昨天你们怎么了？”
text.english: She asked Xie Wendong, “Xie Wendong, what happened to you two yesterday?”

text.chinese: “对不起，昨天我有一点......我和钱大朋……有一点生气。”
text.english: “I’m sorry, yesterday I was a bit... angry with Qian Dapeng.”

text.chinese: 谢文东不知道要怎么说，“可是我们是朋友，这没什么。”
text.english: Xie Wendong didn’t know what to say; “But we are friends, so there’s no problem.”
Zhou Zixin said, “I understand now.”
“We won’t talk about this.”

text.chinese: 谢文东说，“你今天晚上有时间吗？”
text.english: Xie Wendong asked, “Do you have time tonight?”
“I... I have time tonight.”
“Do you know that our family runs a restaurant, right?”

text.chinese: 上个月又开了一个饭店。
text.english: Last month, another restaurant was opened.

text.chinese: 我爸妈叫我去这个饭店吃饭。”
text.english: My parents asked me to eat at this restaurant.
“Did you go there?”
“Not yet.”
I went there today.
“You should come with us too.”
Xie Wendong said.
“Okay, I’ll call a few girls then.”
“Next time.”

text.chinese: 要是你喜欢我家饭店的菜，再带你的朋友去。”
text.english: “If you like the food at my restaurant, bring your friends along.”
“That works too.”
Okay, see you tonight.
Zhou Zixin said happily.

text.chinese: 晚上7点，周子心来到了饭店。
text.english: At 7 p.m., Zhou Zixin arrived at the restaurant.
She saw Xie Wendong.
“Zhou Zi Xin, you’ve come.”
Xie Wendong said happily immediately.

text.chinese: 周子心笑了笑说，“文东，你今天为什么不跟我一起来？”
text.english: Zhou Zixin smiled and said, “Wen Dong, why don’t you come with me today?”
“Qian Dapeng will get angry if he sees it.”
Wen Dong said carefully.
“Why is he angry?”
Zhou Zixin asked.
“Let’s not talk about him, let’s order food.”

text.chinese: 谢文东又笑了，“喜欢吃什么都可以，不要看多少钱。”
text.english: Xie Wendong laughed again, “You can eat whatever you like, don’t care about the cost.”
“No.”
“I can’t do that.”

text.chinese: 周子心也笑了，“我们两个人，点两个菜可以了。”
text.english: Zhou Zixin also smiled, “Just two dishes for the two of us, that’s enough.”

text.chinese: “那不行，你是我朋友，我带你来我家饭店吃饭，不能点那么少！
text.english: “That’s not okay. You’re my friend. I brought you to my restaurant for dinner—you can’t order so little!”
“If you don’t do it, I’ll do it.”

text.chinese: 说完，谢文东一下子点了五个菜。
text.english: After speaking, Xie Wendong ordered five dishes immediately.

text.chinese: “你点太多了，我们两个人吃不完的。”
text.english: “You’ve ordered too much—we won’t be able to finish it.”
Spoken by Zhou Zixin.
“Not a little at all.”
Xie Wendong said.

text.chinese: 谢文东和周子心还在饭店吃饭的时候，钱大朋也到了饭店。
text.english: While Xie Wendong and Zhou Zixin were still eating at the restaurant, Qian Dapeng also arrived at the restaurant.

text.chinese: 钱大朋看到了谢文东的爸妈。
text.english: Qian Dapeng saw Xie Wendong's parents.
“Dapeng, it’s been a long time since we last saw each other.”

text.chinese: 谢爸爸和谢妈妈说，“今天没跟文东一起过来？”
text.english: Dad Xie and Mom Xie said, “Didn’t you come here with Wen Dong today?”
“Wen Dong didn’t come?”

text.chinese: 我听说他今天带女朋友一起过来的。”
text.english: I heard that he came today with his girlfriend.
Qian Dapeng smiled.
“Wen Dong has a girlfriend now?”

text.chinese: 谢爸爸问，“我怎么没听他说过.......”“我也没听他说过。”
text.english: Dad Xie asked, “Why don’t I hear him say that.......” “I also don’t hear him say it.”
Mom Xie also said so.

text.chinese: “我也是听他女朋友的一个朋友说的。”
text.english: “I also heard it from a friend of his girlfriend.”
Qian Dapeng says.
“Okay, we understand.”
I will ask him.
Dad Xie said.
“Has Wen Dong arrived?”
“Where is he?”
Mom Xie said happily.

text.chinese: “我怎么没看到他......”“在那里，你看！”
text.english: “Why don’t I see him...” “Over there, look!”

text.chinese: 钱大朋对谢妈妈说，“文东！”
text.english: Qian Dapeng said to Mother Xie, “Wen Dong!”
Qian Dapeng calls out.

text.chinese: 饭店里有很多人在说话，谢文东没听见。
text.english: There were many people talking in the restaurant, and Xie Wendong didn’t hear them.
“He didn’t hear it.”
“Let’s go back and check it out.”
Mom says, “Thank you.”
“Wen Dong.”

text.chinese: 谢爸爸叫，“你什么时候来的，也不跟我们说？”
text.english: Dad Xie asked, “When did you come here? Didn’t you tell us?”
“Dad?”

text.chinese: 谢文东说，“你们今天怎么在店里……”“这是我们的饭店！
text.english: Xie Wendong said, “Why are you two in the store today…” “This is our restaurant!”
“Let’s take a look.”
Mom said, “Thank you.”
“Wen Dong, is this your girlfriend?”
Wen Dong doesn’t know what to say.
“My name is Zhou Zixin, and I’m a friend of Wen Dong.”

text.chinese: 周子心说，“可是，我不是他女朋友。”
text.english: Zhou Zixin said, “But I am not his girlfriend.”

text.chinese: “文东，你妈问你，你为什么不说话？”
text.english: “Wen Dong, your mom asked you, why don’t you speak?”
Dad Xie asks.
“No… not a girlfriend…” Wen Dong said.

text.chinese: “文东，那你知不知道她有没有男朋友？”
text.english: “Wen Dong, do you know if she has a boyfriend?”
Mom Xie asks again.

text.chinese: “妈，你第一次和她见面，问这么多？”
text.english: “Mom, you’re meeting her for the first time—why so many questions?”
Wen Dong is a little unhappy.
“Can I ask a question?”
I care about you very much.
Mom Xie isn’t angry.
“You come over but don’t tell us anything.”

text.chinese: 谢爸爸听起来有一点不开心，“你能不能多回来看看我们？”
text.english: Dad Xie sounds a bit unhappy, “Could you come back more often to see us?”
“Dad, Mom, I understand…” Wen Dong said.

text.chinese: “大朋不说，我们都不知道你今天过来了。”
text.english: “Without Dapeng saying anything, we had no idea you came today.”
Dad Xie said again.
“Da Peng?”

text.chinese: 大朋怎么会知道我过来了……”文东看了一下周子心。
text.english: “Dapeng how could he know I came here…” Wen Dong glanced at Zhou Zixin.
“Are you asking me?”

text.chinese: 周子心说，“我一点也不知道，可是我跟我的两个朋友说了晚上要出去吃饭。
text.english: Zhou Zixin said, “I have no idea, but I told two of my friends that we were going out to eat tonight.”

text.chinese: 可能大朋问过她们……”文东看起来一点也不开心。
text.english: “Maybe Da Peng asked them…” Wen Dong didn’t look happy at all.
“Dapeng is still in the store, right?”
He asked his father.
“Still there, in that place.”
“I have something to say to him.”
After saying that, Xie Wendong walked over.
“You also eat.”

text.chinese: 周子心对谢爸爸谢妈妈笑了笑。
text.english: Zhou Zixin smiled at Father Xie and Mother Xie.
Xie Wendong has left.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈马上问周子心：“你这么好看，怎么没有男朋友？”
text.english: Mom Xie immediately asked Zhou Zixin, “You look so beautiful, why don’t you have a boyfriend?”

text.chinese: “我有过男朋友，可是，我们不在一起了。”
text.english: “I had a boyfriend, but we aren’t together anymore.”
Spoken by Zhou Zixin.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈问：“那你说说，你喜欢什么样的男生？”
text.english: Mom Xie asked, “So tell me, what kind of boy do you like?”

text.chinese: 周子心笑了一下，不说话。
text.english: Zhou Zixin smiled but said nothing.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈看她不说话，又问：“你看我儿子文东怎么样？”
text.english: Mom Xie seeing she didn’t speak, asked again, “How is my son Wen Dong?”

text.chinese: 周子心笑了一下，对谢爸爸和谢妈妈说：“文东对他的朋友都很好。
text.english: Zhou Zixin smiled and said to Father Xie and Mother Xie, “Wen Dong is very kind to his friends.”

text.chinese: 可是他不是我喜欢的男生，不是你们想的那样。”
text.english: But he’s not the guy I like; not in the way you think.”
“What about Qian Dapeng?”
Do you like Qian Dapeng?
Mom Xie smiled and asked again.
“Qian Dapeng?”
Zhou Zixin asked.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈笑了笑，没说什么。
text.english: Mom Xie smiled but said nothing.

text.chinese: 她知道，自己的儿子喜欢这个女生。
text.english: She knows that her son likes this girl.

text.chinese: 可是钱大朋，她儿子的好朋友，也喜欢这个女生。
text.english: But Qian Dapeng, her son’s good friend, also likes this girl.

text.chinese: 周子心看了一下谢妈妈，说：“钱大朋也是我的朋友。
text.english: Zhou Zixin looked at Mom Xie and said, “Qian Dapeng is also my friend.”

text.chinese: 可是，他也不是我喜欢的男生。”
text.english: But he’s not the type of boy I like either.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈笑了：“那他们知道吗？”
text.english: Mom Xie smiled and asked, “Do they know about that?”

text.chinese: “我们没有说过，他们也没问过我。”
text.english: “We didn’t say it, and they didn’t ask me.”
Zhou Zixin spoke very carefully.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈笑了笑，没说什么。
text.english: Mom Xie smiled but said nothing.
“Qian Dapeng!”

text.chinese: 谢文东很生气，“你跟我去外面，我有话要跟你说！”
text.english: Xie Wendong was very angry. “Come with me outside, I have something to say to you!”
“Do you have anything to say?”
I also have something to say!
When outside, Qian Dapeng started shouting.

text.chinese: “我问你，你跟我爸妈说了什么？”
text.english: “I ask you, what did you tell my parents?”
“I said what you did.”
Da Peng says.
“I didn’t do anything!”

text.chinese: 谢文东大叫，“我跟周子心是朋友！
text.english: Xie Wendong shouted, “I am a friend of Zhou Zixin!”
“Friend!”

text.chinese: “那你为什么要带她来饭店吃饭？！”
text.english: “Then why did you bring her to a restaurant to eat?!”

text.chinese: “我和周子心是朋友，你知道吗？
text.english: “I’m friends with Zhou Zixin, do you know that?”

text.chinese: 我和她一起吃个饭，那又怎么样？”
text.english: “I’ll have dinner with her, so what if?”
Wen Dong shouted loudly.
“Friend?”

text.chinese: 今天是朋友，明天是什么？”
text.english: Today is friends, what about tomorrow?

text.chinese: 大朋还是很生气，“女朋友！
text.english: Dapeng is still very angry, “Girlfriend!”
Do I know nothing?
Are we friends?!”

text.chinese: “你那天还带她去书店和小吃店了！
text.english: “You also took her to a bookstore and snack shop that day!”

text.chinese: 要是我没看到你们，过几天她可能是你女朋友了吧？”
text.english: “If I didn’t see you two, maybe in a few days she will be your girlfriend?”
Xie Wendong said.
“We read books, nothing more!”
Qian Dapeng says.
“Then let’s eat; there’s nothing else!”
Xie Wendong said.

text.chinese: 两个人都很生气，也都不说话了。
text.english: Both of them were very angry and didn’t say a word.

text.chinese: 过了一会儿，谢文东问大朋：“我们是朋友吗？”
text.english: After a while, Xie Wendong asked Da Peng, "Are we friends?"

text.chinese: 大朋看了看谢文东，说：“文东，我们都喜欢这个女生。
text.english: Dapeng looked at Xie Wendong and said, “Wendong, we all like this girl.”

text.chinese: 可是，我们是那么好的朋友……”大朋不说了。
text.english: “But we are such good friends…” Da Peng stopped speaking.

text.chinese: “我喜欢她，可是，我做得一点也不对。”
text.english: “I like her, but I didn’t do anything right.”

text.chinese: 文东看看大朋，说：“我也要你这个朋友。”
text.english: Wen Dong looks at Da Peng and says, "I want to be your friend too."
“This is also what I want to say.”
Both of them laughed.

text.chinese: 星期天，谢文东回家吃饭，谢妈妈问：“儿子，你跟大朋还好吧？
text.english: On Sunday, Xie Wendong went home for dinner, and Xie’s mother asked, “Son, how is it with Da Peng?”

text.chinese: 那天看你们两个一点也不开心。”
text.english: I wasn’t happy at all when I saw you two that day.
“Nothing.”
“All is fine.”
Xie Wendong smiled.

text.chinese: “对了，那天你和周子心都说什么了？”
text.english: “By the way, what did you two say that day?”
“Do you want to hear it?”
“Then don’t get angry.”

text.chinese: 谢妈妈笑了一下，说：“那天她说，你不是她喜欢的男生。”
text.english: Mom Xie smiled and said, “That day, she said you aren’t the boy she likes.”

text.chinese: 谢文东听了，看了看妈妈。
text.english: Xie Wendong listened and looked at his mother.

text.chinese: 谢妈妈笑了笑说：“儿子，周子心说她也不喜欢大朋。”
text.english: Mom Xie smiled and said, “Son, Zhou Zixin also says she doesn’t like Da Peng.”
“I’m not angry.”

text.chinese: 文东笑了笑说，“我昨天看到她跟一个男生走在一起，两个人笑得很开心。”
text.english: Wen Dong smiled and said, “Yesterday I saw her walking with a boy, and they were laughing happily.”

text.chinese: 过了几天，钱大朋对谢文东说：“周子心的男朋友，你知道是谁吗？”
text.english: After a few days, Qian Dapeng asked Xie Wendong, “Who is Zhou Zixin’s boyfriend? Do you know who it is?”

text.chinese: 他们很长时间都没有说过周子心的名字了。
text.english: They haven’t mentioned Zhou Zixin’s name for a long time.

text.chinese: “他也是我们中山大学的大学生。
text.english: “He is also a student at Sun Yat-sen University.”
The teachers really like him.

text.chinese: 听说，他下个月要出国了。”
text.english: I heard that he is going abroad next month.
Wen Dong says.
“Is that possible?
“What about Zhou Zixin?”
Qian Dapeng asks.
“I don’t know, maybe we can go together.”
Xie Wendong said.
“Do you... still like her?”
Xie Wendong asks.

text.chinese: “我不喜欢周子心了，我有喜欢的女生了。
text.english: “I don’t like Zhou Zixin anymore; I have a girl I like now.”
You?

text.chinese: 你问这个，你是不是还喜欢周子心？”
text.english: You ask this—do you still like Zhou Zixin?

text.chinese: 钱大朋笑了笑，和文东说。
text.english: Qian Dapeng smiled and said to Wen Dong.
“I also have a girl I like.”
Xie Wendong also laughed.

text.chinese: 谢文东又说：“那个女生做的小吃很好吃，你也吃过。
text.english: Xie Wendong said again, “The snack the girl made is very delicious; you have also eaten it.”

text.chinese: 她也喜欢……”钱大朋一下子想到了什么：“你说的那个女生是……上次我们和朋友一起吃饭的时候……？”
text.english: She also likes it… Qian Dapeng suddenly remembered something: “That girl you mentioned… was… the one we ate with friends last time…?”
“The friend’s girlfriend’s friend?”

text.chinese: 谢文东不笑了，“你也喜欢？”
text.english: Xie Wendong stopped laughing. “Do you like it too?”

text.chinese: 钱大朋看了看谢文东，谢文东看了看钱大朋。
text.english: Qian Dapeng looked at Xie Wendong, and Xie Wendong looked at Qian Dapeng.

text.chinese: 谢文东说：“大朋，我们是不是好朋友？”
text.english: Xie Wendong said, “Dapeng, are we good friends?”

summary.chinese: 故事读完了。钱大朋和谢文东终于说出了真正想说的话。
summary.english: Story complete. Qian Dapeng and Xie Wendong finally said what they truly meant.
